// Per-corner elliptical rounding radii for converting rectangles to paths, in
// the order top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left. Each radius is an
// (x, y) half-extent pair; a zero pair means a sharp corner.
type CornerRadii2D
    implements IValue
{
    TopLeft: Number2;
    TopRight: Number2;
    BottomRight: Number2;
    BottomLeft: Number2;
}
